name: Canon Palm
description: Strike with a palm set on the canon's first line so the blow lands true and heavy on the chest.

name: Fixed Posture
description: Lock the whole body into one fixed posture of order qi that no push or pull can shift.

name: Statute Pace
description: Take one fixed pace forward whose length the canon sets so the user arrives ready to strike.

name: Edict Eye
description: Read the weak line in an opponent's stance and know where the next blow must fall.

name: Binding Law
description: Lay a law of stillness on one limb so it hangs fixed and the opponent cannot raise it.

name: Rule Surge
description: Release a surge of qi along the canon's line through the palm into the target's centre.

name: Edict Hammer
description: Bring a hammering fist down with the weight of an edict that breaks a guard and the bone behind it.

name: Law Aegis
description: Raise a bastion of ordered qi round the user that holds its shape against repeated heavy strikes.

name: Written Fist
description: Throw a fist that lands by the letter of its stroke and cannot be talked out of its mark.

name: Written Guard
description: Turn each blow on a fixed written angle so the guard never has to choose its answer.

name: Clause Step
description: Slip one clean pace to the flank that the opponent's own stance has already allowed.

name: Lash Mark
description: Tag the foe's shoulder with a thread of qi that tugs the arm back to a fixed line.

name: Strand Parse
description: Read the terms of an opposing hold so the user knows which strand to cut to be free.

name: Seal Palm
description: Press a palm on the opponent and seal one channel of qi shut so a technique fails to start.

name: Chain of Clauses
description: Link thread after thread of order qi round a foe until every joint is held by a separate clause.

name: Clear Charge
description: Strike a binding or a curse laid on an ally with its own terms and strip it clean off them.

name: Decree of Stillness
description: Decree stillness on a single foe so that its qi and its limbs hold motionless while the decree stands.

name: Statute Seal
description: Seal an opponent's strongest technique under statute so it cannot be used again for a time.

name: Steady Jab
description: Jab along the stable field's edge so the strike meets no shift or sway from the air.

name: Anchored Guard
description: Anchor a guard into the field so wild force striking it loses its energy and drops.

name: Smooth Glide
description: Glide over the field's even footing in steady paces that never trip or slow.

name: Stable Reading
description: Feel through the field every person and force inside it without looking.

name: Steady Dome
description: Draw the field into a close dome over the user and any ally that stands beside them.

name: Hush Pulse
description: Pulse the field outward and slow every moving force it crosses until it creeps to a halt.

name: Reform Lattice
description: Weave the field through an ally's qi channels to set a backlash right and ease deviated flow.

name: Calm Domain
description: Hold the whole field steady so every ally inside moves with a clear head and a settled guard.

name: Settling Crush
description: Drop the field's full calm onto one area as a pressing weight that flattens force and flesh together.

name: Course Palm
description: Strike with a palm laid over a measured course so the blow falls where the measure says.

name: Layered Plate
description: Raise a first thin plate of qi to take the force of a blow.

name: Second Layer
description: Add a second plate behind the first that catches whatever force passes the front layer.

name: Plate Pace
description: Advance a pace behind the raised plates so the wall moves with the user.

name: Plate Push
description: Thrust the raised plates forward as a flat slab to shove back whatever stands before them.

name: Plate Count
description: Count the layers aloud in the mind to hold each at its full strength through a long exchange.

name: Plated Order
description: Raise a long rampart of order qi that shelters several allies standing behind it.

name: Rebound Face
description: Tilt the wall's face so a heavy strike is sent back at the one that threw it.

name: Shared Measure
description: Share the wall's measure with an ally so their guard holds as firmly as the user's own.

name: Full Bulwark
description: Raise every layer of the wall together into one unbroken bulwark that stops a charge cold.

name: Plate Topple
description: Topple the standing wall onto the ground ahead so its whole mass crushes all within reach.

name: Ledger Palm
description: Strike a palm into the foe and mark the hit as a debt entered against it.

name: Entry Guard
description: Turn a blow aside and enter its force into the ledger to be repaid in kind.

name: Account Step
description: Step in as the last blow is entered and close to arm's reach before the foe recovers.

name: Tally Sense
description: Count how much force the foe has already sent and how much it has left to spend.

name: Owed Mark
description: Mark the opponent with a lien of order qi that drags each of its moves a little behind.

name: Stamp Seal
description: Stamp a seal on a foe's arm so the technique built through it is closed for a breath.

name: Settle the Debt
description: Pay back every marked blow at once in a single concentrated strike to the debtor.

name: Final Account
description: Call the whole ledger due in one blow that returns the sum of all force the foe has dealt.

name: Closed Ledger
description: Close the account on a foe and seal its qi against all further drawing on the debt.

name: Correcting Palm
description: Strike with an open hand that corrects a stance by knocking the flawed limb into line.

name: Open Guard
description: Open the hand and turn a strike aside so lightly it seems the blow chose its own path.

name: Gentle Pace
description: Move in a quiet even pace that carries the user inside a wide swing without alarm.

name: Fault Sight
description: Pick out the single flaw in a rival's rhythm that a corrected strike can exploit.

name: Right the Wrist
description: Straighten the foe's wrist by force into the correct line so that its grip fails.

name: Tidy Breath
description: Tidy the user's breath into a clean regular pattern that frees qi for the next technique.

name: Rectify Form
description: Straighten a collapsed technique in an ally and clear the poison or taint that warped it.

name: Disarm Pattern
description: Reach a hand into a foe's rising technique and pull its first strand so it unravels.

name: Measured Mercy
description: Lay a hand on an ally and set their strained muscles and torn flesh back to their proper form.

name: Rewrite Qi
description: Rewrite an ally's scattered qi into an orderly pattern so their next technique runs stronger.

name: Perfect Correction
description: Correct every flaw in a stricken ally at once and clear deviation and curses from body and qi.

name: Unmaking Hand
description: Close the hand on a gathered technique and undo it entirely before its blow can fall.

name: Pendulum Palm
description: Swing a palm on a fixed arc whose period the user never alters so it lands on time.

name: Swing Guard
description: Swing a forearm out and back on its fixed arc and brush each strike off its line.

name: Rocking Step
description: Rock the weight forward and back in steady time and step off on the forward swing.

name: Plumb Drop
description: Drop the arm on the plumb line of the foe's balance at the bottom of the swing.

name: Period Sense
description: Learn the exact period of an opponent's repeated movement and name the moment it will be open.

name: Long Arc
description: Swing a wide arc that gathers weight over its length and lands harder at the far end.

name: Weighted Swing
description: Sweep a full circle with both arms so the swing strikes every foe within reach.

name: Steady Time
description: Hold the user's swing at one unvarying time so each stroke gains force from the one before.

name: Pendulum Break
description: Let the swing build to its farthest reach and loose it as a blow that shatters stone.

name: Metronome Ward
description: Keep a ward swinging round the user on a fixed beat so each pass meets an incoming blow.

name: Mend Pattern
description: Mend a small flaw in the user's own technique so it runs smooth for the next use.

name: Reform Strike
description: Strike with a technique put back into its correct form and see it land with its first power.

name: Pattern Guard
description: Raise a guard whose layout follows a clean pattern with no weak seam for a blow to find.

name: Weave Sight
description: See the weave of a technique at work and find the strand that holds its structure.

name: Strand Pull
description: Pull the key strand from a foe's technique and watch the whole weave come loose.

name: Restore Weave
description: Restore the torn weave of an ally's technique and clear the backlash left in their channels.

name: Pattern Collapse
description: Collapse every technique being woven within reach by cutting the pattern all share.

name: Whole Restoration
description: Restore the techniques and the channels of several allies at once to their proper working order.

name: Parity Palm
description: Strike with a level palm inside the domain where the blow's force is kept exactly what was meant.

name: Fair Footing
description: Make the ground of the domain even underfoot so the user moves over it without stumbling.

name: Domain Ward
description: Draw the domain close as a ward that quiets force striking the user from any side.

name: Domain Edge
description: Know the exact reach of the domain and every person standing within it.

name: Strip Surge
description: Strip the excess surge from a loose burst of qi that enters the domain and leave it harmless.

name: Level Force
description: Level the force of every ally in the domain to the user's own steady strength.

name: Fair Weight
description: Press down the force of a stronger foe so it matches that of the weakest fighter present.

name: Open Domain
description: Hold the domain steady as an open space where no ambush force can gather unseen.

name: Cleanse Disorder
description: Let the domain's order wash over allies and clear a lingering taint or deviation from their qi.

name: Domain Judgment
description: Pass judgment across the whole domain and press every foe inside to a standstill for a breath.

name: Crushing Level
description: Flatten the domain's floor in one crushing wave that levels all standing on it.
